_tokens.O: nested record: u32 size (counted from the size field itself) + u16 nameIdx + u16 classIdx + payload[size-8]. classIdx 0: nameIdx 0 = null pointer, nameIdx != 0 = by-name reference (8 bytes). IStream slots +0x60..+0x88.
_tokens.LIST: records until a null record (the null record is written; it ends the list). IStream +0x58. The engine stops at the first item that RESOLVES to null: a null record, but also a record of an unregistered class and a by-name reference that names neither a registered object nor a loadable menu file (BF1942 0x007F9130, BFV 0x0087A6F0); never put one of those inside a list.
_tokens.i32: 4-byte little-endian int (signed). IStream +0x3C (Int) and +0x5C (enum; binary streams store the value).
_tokens.s8: u8 length + latin1 bytes, no terminator. IStream +0x4C texture / +0x50 font / +0x54 sound handle name.
_tokens.u16: IStream +0x24/+0x28 - 2 bytes. Used by no class.
_tokens.u32as16: IStream +0x48 - 4 bytes on disk, stored as u16. Used by no class.
_tokens.sidx: ClassIStream +0xA0 - u16 string-table index (the record header uses it). Used by no class payload.

_tree.grammar: TREE0 (0x0087AEB0) := bool present; if present: NODE, TREE0 (child), TREE1 (next), TREE2 (prev). TREE1 (0x0087AAD0) := bool; if present: NODE, TREE0, TREE1. TREE2 (0x0087AF70) := bool; if present: NODE, TREE0, TREE2. NODE = the node class payload (records only).
_tree.note: Only Tree and NavigateTree use it. No corpus file contains either class.

_meta.format: Refractor Meme 2.0 menu files (menu.rfa entries), BF1942 and BF Vietnam
_meta.class_key: short class name; the file stores the full name, e.g. dice::meme::BfButtonNode (Ref2System, registered by both exes, is dice::ref2::menu::Ref2System); the engine also resolves the bare part after the last colon (BF1942 0x007EDEA0, BFV 0x008753F0)
_meta.tokens_order: positional, exactly the order of the class serialize(); the first O of every Node subclass is its SIBLING (Next node)

not_in_schema.IStream/OStream/ClassIStream: stream infrastructure registered as classes, not file objects
not_in_schema.RuntimeObject: BFV RTTI base with no serialize
not_in_schema.BfScrollPictureNode2: declared in the MDT header only; neither exe registers it

conflicts_resolved: PointerXData/PointerYData: MDT header [O Data] vs engines [] (BFV 0x00A7D100, BF1942 0x007F8570) -> engine; every instance is an 8-byte record, the MDT layout breaks 14 retail files
BfLocalePictureButtonNode: MDT Byte Unk1/Unk2 vs engine s8 Picture/Mouse over picture (+0x4C) -> engine; all instances are empty strings, byte-identical either way
BfScrollPictureNode2: MDT-only phantom, registered by neither exe -> excluded

LIST terminator: meme_tree ends at any classless record vs engine (BFV 0x0087A6F0, BF1942 0x007F9130) only when the item resolves to a null pointer -> engine; a resolvable reference is an item, an unresolvable reference or an unregistered class also ends the list; no corpus list holds a reference
u32 vs i32 for 4-byte ints -> i32 (IntData -1 / -705); same bytes

empirical typed 5 zero-valued fields differently (CullNode In/Out time, BfBinkNode Fade time, BfNewListBoxNode sounds + background colour + frame alpha, BfEditNodeInt Focus, SetPathAction bool) -> engine types; same bytes, except CullNode In time, which is 2000.0 (00 00 FA 44) in one BF1942c instance (XWWII-menu/menu/InGame) - plausible only as the engine f32 (as i32: 1157234688)
IStream +0x48: meme_tree parser 2 bytes vs engine 4 bytes stored as u16 -> engine; unused by any class
serialize vtable slot: +0x34 (BFV) vs +0x30 (BF1942); both right for their exe
